name: type-b
description: Type B — A smarter way to enter text. Chrome Extension (Manifest V3).

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && node scripts/make-docs-build.mjs
scripts.build:fast: vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && node scripts/make-docs-build.mjs
scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../type-b-extension.zip . && cd ../dist-docs && zip -r ../type-b-docs-extension.zip .
